title: Installation parts aren't finished or are broken. Ok for shoe storage
text:
Installation parts aren't finished or are broken. Ok for shoe storage. I wanted to love this little cubby bench, yet.... it's only partially functional due to poor materials. First, this is smaller by far than the photos lead you to expect. It's still a very functional size for our needs, but we're off. We'll use it for shoe storage near the front door and as a seat for two short dogs to perch on when we're walking into the house.

Assembly of this bench was ridiculous. There are multiple pegs that hold the base to the vertical shelf walls and the end pieces. These pegs snap in half like a matchstick with any pressure. Three arrived in my box already broken. Then you screw in and use a bolt thing to secure the rest of it. That was easy enough, but two of the holes weren't completely finished, so I had to re-drill them. The end result is that the entire unit is less stable than it should be and I will always be concerned about any weight on it causing a collapse. However, it will still serve as a shoe storage spot.
